scope: Three Nov23 first releases found Nov24; finite selection, no watermark movement

reviews.scope: The independent standard-library CPU kernel solves FTRL's KKT equations: Gk+alpha/sqrt(pk)+beta/pk share a multiplier, found by score translation and bisection rather than a softmax substitute. It implements shared exponential sampling, rho, aggregate residuals, the potential and Algorithm2 restarts. The begin/choose/finish API receives current hints and one terminal aggregate, not turn reward vectors or gold answers/plans. Injected noise is for mathematical controls only. No LLM, activation probe, TACT intervention, code executor, real-task score or Evolve mapping runs. The float64 root solver has numerical tolerance, not infinite precision.
reviews.cost_basis: The full campaign uses a27B model,589 real coding/terminal tasks, Cap/Gate multi-arm comparisons and baselines, with up to256/128 turns. Simulations span10^7-10^8 turns,50 seeds and up to512 arms. This long-rollout/multi-arm campaign exceeds the short one-A100/A30-or-Mac budget and is terminally not reproduced. No checkpoints, benchmarks, APIs or trial runs are launched. Only bounded small-K/L CPU controls run, estimated in seconds pending shared-runner timing.

reviews.scope: The evaluator-side standard-library slice implements scalar bias, AIPW with declared fold provenance, finite-stratum bounded allocation, support outer sets, strict interval rank sets and a log-space hedged e-process. Plan commits m/phi before drawing an audit; observe accepts binary labels only for audited rows and requires None otherwise. Every episode updates. Changed targets, nonfrozen/nonindependent task declarations and lambda not strictly below the positivity floor are rejected. Inversion is only on a predeclared finite theta grid: accepted_grid is not continuous CS endpoints or coverage for off-grid truth. No nuisance fitting, human collection, LLM judge, three-judge latent model, cluster bootstrap or live leaderboard runs. Timing/fold declarations are external statistical contracts, not adversarial information-flow security proofs.
reviews.cost_basis: This is CPU statistical research, not a study that necessarily requires GPUs. The full allocation campaign reaches500 replications by500000 episodes(about250 million episode records), plus250 four-agent replications,48-cell stress tests,200 by3000-step monitoring streams and1000 rank experiments. Some target sizes/executable scripts are not supplied, so full reproduction cost cannot be cheaply established from metadata. The cost gate closes the full campaign without a costly probe; only bounded small-array/exact-design controls execute. No live-judge, human-labeling or GPU cost is measured or invented.

reviews.scope: Review-only delivery records fixed-v1 sources/metadata, access boundaries, costs and a same-topic comparison. No local algorithm module, editor, research broker, video service, harness evolution, benchmark, GPU trial or Evolve operator is created. Gate arithmetic alone would not reproduce MORSE; review-only disposition requires no invented three-seed metrics or GPU receipt.
reviews.cost_basis: Each backbone uses25 rounds with up to six initial candidates per round plus merges. Three separate backbones are Qwen2.5-VL7B,Qwen3-VL8B andQwen3.8-27B, with Claude Opus5.5 editing, multiple CLIP/OCR/VideoMAE/encoder services,780 training/388 validation questions and three test video benchmarks. Host limits allow20000 service calls per episode and131072 context tokens per call. The singleH100 is test-timing hardware, not a complete evolution budget. This clearly exceeds the short one-A100/A30-or-Mac scope; the full system is terminally not reproduced without model/video downloads, services, paid calls or probes.
